objective: Frozen computation: every arrangement of the four not-all-equal-class knots with periods (1,1), (2,1), (1,2), and 150 random each with (3,1), (1,3), (2,2): flip-split transfer spectra (spin and energy gaps) at widths 6 to 12, classification, direct correlations for disordered ones, and the gauge check.
title: Which mixed arrangements on the weave are disordered
